videos.title: "Retreat, Hell!" — How the Marines Fought Their Way Out of Chosin
videos.desc:
November 1950. The 1st Marine Division is deep in the frozen mountains of North Korea, at the end of a single road, under a general his own superiors considered too cautious.

videos.title: Smedley Butler Top 3 Legendary Tactical Moves — He Tried to Give His Medal of Honor Back
videos.desc:
November 1935. A retired Marine general writes: "I was a racketeer, a gangster for capitalism." He was one of only two Marines ever awarded the Medal of Honor twice, for two separate actions.

This is the story of Smedley Butler in three moves: a swamp outside the walls of Tientsin, the streets of Veracruz, and a drain under the wall of Fort Rivière, high on a mountain in Haiti. And of what he did with everything he had seen.

videos.desc:

Six months earlier, Washington had doubted he was big enough for the job. This is the story of Philip Sheridan in three moves - and of the six months that answered that question.

videos.title: Chesty Puller's Top 3 Legendary Tactical Moves | The Most Decorated Marine in History
videos.desc:
Some military legends are built on victories. Others are built on the moments when everything seems to be falling apart.

Chesty Puller became one of the most iconic figures in U.S. Marine Corps history, a name associated with battlefield leadership, extraordinary determination, and an almost legendary refusal to give up. But his legacy is more complicated than the stories told about him.

This documentary explores the life and military career of a remarkable American Marine officer across three wars, examining the decisions, leadership qualities, and controversies that shaped his reputation.

videos.title: The General Stalin Imprisoned, Then Trusted — Rokossovsky's 3 Greatest Moves
videos.desc:

Konstantin Rokossovsky is remembered as one of the great Soviet commanders of the Second World War. Far fewer people know what stood between those two facts — and why the trust he earned was never quite the same as being forgiven. This documentary looks at three moments when the enemy was certain of the outcome, and at the way of thinking that let one general see what everyone else had missed.
